purpose: Methodological and contextual publisher references, not newly downloaded numeric outcome panels or independent validation of a municipality.

items.title: What population change measures
items.finding: Population change has births, deaths and net migration components. Growth alone is not a count of people choosing a place.
items.limitation: No profile-specific migration panel is supplied by this glossary.

items.title: How to interpret location quotients
items.finding: An LQ compares an industry's local share with its share in a reference economy.
items.limitation: Concentration is not company relocation, operating success or available site capacity. This definition does not independently verify Nestlyzer's retained derived LQs.

items.title: Keep evaluation data out of model selection
items.finding: Using test information during model development creates optimistic performance estimates.
items.limitation: Documentation is not a completed validation experiment.

items.title: Separate dependent geographic units and time windows
items.finding: Grouped and temporal splits address dependence that random row splits may miss.
items.limitation: Separate web pages from the same documentation family are not independent outcome evidence.

items.title: Older Americans' moving patterns
items.finding: Census publishes analysis of domestic moves by adults aged 65 and older and distinguishes moves within and between counties.
items.limitation: Age is not pension receipt. Historical national or state findings do not validate every current town's retiree score.

items.title: County migration and retirement destinations
items.finding: Census discusses older-migrant attraction around The Villages and other Southern destinations.
items.limitation: County-level narrative is context, not a downloadable complete age-specific municipal calibration panel. It shares a publisher family with the older-moves reference.
